first.text:
My mistake — it's not on your athlete page. It's at the top of every routine page instead: open any one of them (Monday press, Wednesday pull-ups, Friday squat, Saturday bench, Sunday deadlift, the conditioning circuit or the daily hang) and the first link, labelled "Set up the home kit in plate-pool", is the one you want. Tap it once on your phone and the app opens with your full home kit loaded and saved.

After that, the "Load it in plate-pool" links next to each lift on those same pages will open straight to the right weight on your bar or dumbbells.
